info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Operational Service By Disbursement Id-spec
info.description: This API enables users to modify existing operational services associated with a specific disbursement ID. It allows businesses to streamline updates to service details, ensuring accurate and efficient information management. Typical consumers include financial institutions and operational teams who need to maintain current operational records tied to disbursement processes. Use cases may involve adjusting service parameters or correcting entries related to financial transactions. The endpoint facilitates better transaction tracking and reporting within banking applications.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the attributes of the disbursement resource identified by the unique reference RES-100045. Ensure you provide the necessary information in the request body to apply the changes effectively.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the disbursement details for the specified resource (RES-100045). It should contain the necessary information for the operation, including any changes that need to be applied.
